entries.138e179aa69c3311: It is a car subscription service for individuals that does not require physical stores, with procedures completed entirely online. It offers new and used cars from Japanese manufacturers for a fixed monthly fee, and ancillary services such as vehicle inspection, taxes, maintenance costs, automobile insurance and breakdown warranties can also be selected for a fixed fee. Lease vehicles are owned by partner financial companies, so the company group in principle holds no vehicle inventory.
